content.purpose: Thin explicit-I/O adapter for the deterministic repo-governance core, exposing CLI output, requested artifacts and process status without owning ADR rule meaning.
responsibilities: Read explicit JSON files or stdin.
Invoke repo-governance core with explicit inputs.
Print summary/JSON and violations and optionally write six requested artifacts.
Return process status for valid, violated and tool-error cases.
nonResponsibilities: New ADR rule meaning or business judgment.
Core domain processing and final merge/cutover authority.

content.description: Python module CLI with --adr-bundle, --repo-snapshot, optional --out-dir, --output summary|json; checks via imported evaluate; encodes output to stdout/stderr and files, returns status.

input.description: Named ADR bundle path, repo snapshot path and optional output parameters; files/stdin are read by load_json.

output.description: Summary or serialized JSON to stdout; optional generated output files; violations to stderr.

error.description: ValueError, JSONDecodeError and OSError caught inside main return 2; parser argument errors occur before the try and argparse exits with status 2; uncaught unexpected errors may propagate.

effect.description: Reads explicit files/stdin; prints to stdout/stderr; writes only when --out-dir is supplied, using mkdir and direct per-file writes.

dependencies.condition: repo_governance module resolvable on Python import path
dependencies.purpose: Delegates rule evaluation to non-authority core

content.responsibility: CLI main module supplies JSON decoding, parser and output adapters; package __init__ has only docstring.

input.description: Python module imports argparse, json, sys, Path and evaluate.

output.description: Definitions load_json, write_outputs, build_parser and main.

error.description: Imports can fail when repo_governance is not resolvable.

effect.description: CLI execution is guarded by __main__; import alone does not call main in this module.

content.responsibility: Read explicit JSON input and require top-level object

input.description: JSON path string, or '-' for stdin

effect.description: Read caller-supplied file path or sys.stdin

output.description: Parser with two required paths and optional directory/output format

error.description: argparse errors on invalid or absent arguments

input.description: Output dir path and core evaluation result mapping

output.description: Writes five JSON files and readme.generated.md

error.description: OSError or missing result keys may abort an intermediate write

effect.description: Creates directories and writes six files in sequence; no atomic multi-file transaction

content.responsibility: Orchestrate parse, load, evaluate, optional export and status

input.description: Optional argv or sys.argv; explicit paths refer to JSON bundle and snapshot

output.description: Print summary or JSON, diagnostics; return 0 for pass, 1 for violations, 2 for caught tool errors

error.description: Parse errors exit argparse before try; OSError/ValueError/JSONDecodeError within try yield 2; unexpected errors are not caught

effect.description: Explicit file/stdin reads, optional output directory writes, stdout/stderr emission
